title: Natural coordinates for constrained correlation functions: Partial autocorrelations and the geometry of positive power spectra
summary: Two-point correlation functions are a standard summary statistic in cosmic shear and large-scale-structure analyses. Their values are, however, constrained: non-negativity of the underlying power spectrum restricts any admissible sequence of correlation coefficients $(r_1,\ldots,r_N)$ to a bounded convex region, described in the one-dimensional case by the recursive interval geometry of Schneider & Hartlap (2009).
